task.task: Implement absolute_distance(a, b), returning the non-negative absolute difference between two numbers.

parsel:
absolute_distance(a, b): Call subtract to compute a minus b, then call absolute_value and return the non-negative result
  subtract(a, b): Return a minus b
  absolute_value(value): Return value when it is non-negative and otherwise return its negation

task.task: Read whitespace-separated integers from standard input and print their sum followed by a newline.

parsel:
sum_stdin(): Read all standard input, call parse_integers and total_values, then print the integer total followed by one newline
  parse_integers(text): Return the whitespace-separated integers in text as a list, or an empty list for empty input
  total_values(values): Return the sum of values, using zero for an empty list
